parsed.name: Sensirion 传感器桥 I2C 设备接口
parsed.name_en: Sensirion Sensor Bridge I2C Device Interface
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件控制组件，用于表示通过 Sensirion Sensor Bridge 连接的通用 I2C 外设，而不是某一台特定的独立仪器。它在实验中用于设置目标 I2C 地址、控制桥接口对外设的供电、输出连接信息，并在使用结束后关闭通信会话。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component representing a generic I2C peripheral connected through a Sensirion Sensor Bridge, rather than a specific standalone instrument. In laboratory use, it is used to set the target I2C address, control bridge power to the peripheral, print connection information, and close the communication session when finished.

actions.description: 初始化通过 Sensirion 传感器桥连接的 I2C 设备地址。
actions.description_en: Initialize the I2C device address for a peripheral connected through the Sensirion Sensor Bridge.

actions.description: 打印桥接连接设备的信息。
actions.description_en: Print information about the bridge-connected device.

actions.description: 打开桥接口对已连接 I2C 设备的供电。
actions.description_en: Turn on power from the bridge interface to the connected I2C device.

actions.description: 关闭桥接口对已连接 I2C 设备的供电。
actions.description_en: Turn off power from the bridge interface to the connected I2C device.

actions.description: 关闭与桥接 I2C 设备的通信会话。
actions.description_en: Close the communication session with the bridge-connected I2C device.
